name: TerraLink
tagline: An agent that finds credible solar, wind, hydro and geothermal sites from free satellite data in minutes.

awards: Best Overall Hack [Courtesy of Amplitude, Anthropic, OpenAI]

problem: Renewable site selection takes analysts 6–18 months and consultant fees, the team says, slowing the energy transition.
solution: An agentic system queries satellite and geospatial data through Earth Engine, scores candidate sites for each energy type and explains them on a map.
demo_moment: Team-described: ask for wind sites in Utah and get ranked candidates on a map.

why_it_stood_out.claim: Won “Best Overall Hack [Courtesy of Amplitude, Anthropic, OpenAI]” and “Best Sustainability Hack [Courtesy of EaglePlan]” among 195 submissions.
Turns expert geospatial work into a minutes-long query.
A two-person team won Best Overall and sustainability.

lessons: Compress an expensive expert workflow into a demo that runs in the room.
